_baselineNote: EQT's default forecast anchors 2026/2027/2028 total production to its guided FY2026 total (2,375-2,450 Bcfe, mid 2,412.5, raised this cycle), held flat forward (no 2027/2028 production guidance). The gas/liquids split derives gas as the guided total less EQT's separately guided FY2026 total liquids sales volume (14,200-15,000 MBbl, mid 14,600); NGL vs. oil within liquids uses EQT's own Q2 2026 reported ratio (oil ~7.5% of liquids). EQT guides its cost structure component-by-component (opex_loe, opex_gathering+opex_transmission+opex_processing summed, opex_production_taxes converted to %-of-revenue, opex_sga) -- used directly, no proportional scaling needed (unlike CNX). EQT does not guide a gas, oil, or NGL price/differential this cycle; all three default to EQT's own Q2 2026 realized-price decomposition, independently verified against EQT's Form 10-Q MD&A reconciliation table (NYMEX $2.89/MMBtu + Btu uplift $0.16 + basis $(0.67) = disclosed 'average adjusted price' $2.38/Mcf, reconciling exactly). Capital budget is synthesized from two separately-guided FY2026 figures (capex_maintenance $2,115mm + capex growth $610mm = $2,725mm) that management did not restate as one total. The guided FY2026 annual-average production/mix run below the Q2 2026 single-quarter print (Q2 was evidently a seasonally/timing-elevated quarter); this engine intentionally uses the guided annual figures over a naive Q2 annualization, per the source-precedence rules (exact-year management guidance outranks extrapolating one quarter). Default-forecast implied share price ($37.63) runs well below EQT's actual Q2 2026 close ($53.17) -- a wider gap than AR or CNX, plausibly reflecting EQT's separately guided but unmodeled value drivers (Southeast Utility uplift ~$300mm/yr from 2027-28, CPV Shay FCF uplift, LNG offtake optionality) that this engine's standard commodity-revenue model does not capture; a disclosed, understood limitation. Net debt declines dollar-for-dollar with cumulative forecast FCF only (no dividends/buybacks/financing modeled).
